name: lanplay
description: LanPlay: one simple app that sets up Sunshine (Windows host) and launches Moonlight (Mac client) on your own LAN.

scripts.pack:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dir --arm64 --publish never
scripts.pack:win: npm run build && node scripts/ensure-koffi-native.mjs win32-x64 && electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.cjs --win dir --x64 --publish never
